name: Mail And Content Protect – keep emails and content safe from misuse
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Stop spam bots from harvesting your email addresses and keep sensitive content protected – with one simple Gutenberg block.

Why Mail And Content Protect?

Publishing an email address or phone number on your site is an open invitation for spam bots. Mail And Content Protect is a robust plugin designed to safeguard your emails and content from spam and unauthorized access, so you can share contact details with real visitors without feeding the scrapers.

The block supports four content types – Content, Email, Phone Number, and URL – and comes with customizable options, so you can tailor the protection measures to suit your specific needs. You can also set the typography and color of the secured values so they blend perfectly with your design.

Add the block anywhere in the Gutenberg editor, pick the content type, and adjust everything from the settings sidebar – no code required.

Free Features

  • Four Content Types: Protect Content, Email, Phone Number, and URL values.
  • Customizable Protection: Tailor the protection measures to suit your specific needs.
  • Typography & Color Controls: Style the secured values to match your site.
  • Gutenberg Native: Add and configure the block directly in the editor’s settings sidebar.
  • Unlimited Use: Reuse the block as many times as you want.

How to Use – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the Mail And Content Protect plugin.
  2. In the Gutenberg editor, add the Mail And Content Protect block from the “Widgets” block category.
  3. Choose the content type (Content, Email, Phone Number, or URL) and enter your value.
  4. Adjust the settings from the right-side settings sidebar.
  5. Publish – your content is protected.

Use Cases

  • Contact Pages: Show your email and phone number without exposing them to spam bots.
  • Business Sites: Protect client or partner contact details on public pages.
  • Blogs & Communities: Keep selected content and links restricted from unauthorized access.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Mail And Content Protect”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. In the Gutenberg editor, search for the Mail And Content Protect block and add it to any post or page.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the mail-and-content-protect plugin (.zip file).
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the mail-and-content-protect.zip file, click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Alternatively, upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory and activate it from the Plugins menu.
sections.faq:
Is Mail And Content Protect free?

Yes, Mail And Content Protect is a free Gutenberg block plugin.

What types of content can I protect?

The block supports four content types: Content, Email, Phone Number, and URL.

Can I style the protected values?

Yes. You can set the typography and color of the secured values so they match your site’s design.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse the block?

You can use the block unlimited times across your site.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here.
